name: Janus kinase 1

function.text: JAK1 encodes tyrosine-protein kinase JAK1. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and non-membrane spanning protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and cell differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autoinflammation, immune dysregulation, and eosinophilia (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia; T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; Enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
